description: A sealed class representing the result of an API call, encapsulating success, error, and loading states, along with a utility function to perform API calls.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: A sealed class that represents different states of an API call result, including success, error, and loading.

classes.name: Success
classes.description: A data class representing a successful result containing the associated data.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: A data class representing an error state that holds information about the exception.

classes.name: Loading
classes.description: An object representing a loading state while an API call is in progress.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps the success state of the Result using a provided transform function.

methods.name: apiCall
methods.description: A utility inline function that executes an API call and returns a Result indicating success or failure.
